inlines.v: INHOS'PITABLE, adjective [in and hospitable.] 1. Not hospitable; not disposed to entertain strangers gratuitously; declining to entertain guests, or entertaining them with reluctance; as an inhospitable person or people. 2. Affording no conveniences, subsistence or shelter to strangers; as inhospitable desserts or rocks.
